extracted.intended_audience: public relations practitioners, communications students, and media/PR professionals (including those who write press releases)
extracted.subtask_description: A comprehensive handbook of public relations and communications covering principles, media relations, sector-specific PR (corporate, nonprofit, government, political), research and planning, communications media, legal/ethical standards, and professional codes. Useful as a reference for producing and evaluating PR materials such as press releases, campaigns, and stakeholder communications.
